limitations: Runtime/source matrix has only three fresh-process samples per cell; sequential runs do not eliminate all host variation.
Causal preparation experiments intentionally perform setup before click and report its full duration plus main-thread LongTasks/heartbeat. They are not product-fix acceptance measurements.
Fake microphone, hidden windows, loopback, filtered external STUN/TURN and muted physical audio do not validate WAN/TURN or physical-device output latency.

The harness installs observation after launch then reloads the packaged page before UI login. A product startup query may begin during initial page load; observed later query timing must not be represented as uncached process-start timing.
The first two phase cohorts predate LongTask and Playwright asset-request collection; absent fields are null, not evidence of zero work.

implementationVerification.sourceIsolation: Owned voice changes transferred to a separate worktree; unrelated concurrent screen-sharing edits were excluded and left intact. Independent review passed.
changes: Windows Electron queries hardware encoder capabilities asynchronously during application startup, without capture, encoder allocation, peer connection or room creation. Readiness gates encrypted voice admission, with a two-second fallback; encryption preparation continues in parallel.

A cached dynamic-import loader replaces voice-specific React.lazy/Suspense wrappers in all three AppLayout branches. It preserves active-session loading, stable provider identity, obsolete-mount retirement and existing error-boundary retries.
Earlier request cancellation, server activity queue and deafened channel-cue fixes remain included.
